tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Browse AppScreenshoot's published App Store and Google Play screenshot templates. Filter by category, visual style, free tier, or a keyword. Returns the template slug, name, colors, first preview image, and links to its detail page and editor.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get one AppScreenshoot screenshot template in detail, including its connected screen sequence, headline and subtitle copy, preview images, canvas size, and editor link. Use this after list_templates to inspect or recommend a specific design.

tools.name: get_screenshot_specs
tools.description: Look up current App Store and Google Play screenshot requirements: exact pixel sizes, accepted formats, minimum and maximum screenshot counts, transparency rules, and official Apple or Google sources. Filter by store or device type.
